commands.name: apply_movement

args.name: actor
args.description: The actor's id in the zone's events; 255 for the player

args.name: movement
args.description: Its steps, [walk_up(2), face_left], or a movement NAME = [...] of this file

commands.description: Starts a movement on an actor (by its id; 255 for the player): its steps in [ ], as [walk_up(2), face_left], or a movement's name; wait_movement() waits for it to end

commands.name: wait_movement
commands.description: Waits until every movement started ends

commands.name: get_player_direction
commands.description: Returns the direction the player is facing

commands.name: start_trainer_battle
commands.description: Initiates a trainer battle with the provided trainers Setting trainer2 will result in a double battle, leaving it as 0 with result in a single battle Setting canBlackout to 1 will allow the script to continue if the player loses the fight

commands.name: start_multi_trainer_battle
commands.description: Initiates a multi battle with the provided trainers

commands.name: trainer_battle_lose
commands.description: Blackout sequence from losing a trainer battle

commands.name: get_trainer_battle_result
commands.description: Returns 1 if the player won the last trainer battle, 0 if the player lost

commands.name: trainer_battle_end
commands.description: Restore the overworld scene after a trainer battle

commands.name: get_version
commands.description: Returns 0 for white, 1 for black

commands.name: get_hero_gender

commands.name: check_money
commands.description: Returns 1 if the player has the amount of money specified

commands.description: Modifies a pokemon's friendship value based on the provided mode 0 - set to value 1 - add value 2 - subtract value

commands.description: Returns the number of pokemon in the players party that match a certain condition mode 0 - Number of filled slots mode 1 - Number of non egg pokemon mode 2 - Number of pokemon that can battle mode 3 - Number of eggs mode 4 - ??? mode 5 - Number of empty slots

commands.name: heal_pokemon
commands.description: Fully heals the pokemon in the player's party

commands.description: Opens the menu to replace a pokemon's move with a new one Returns a success variable and the move slot that was selected

commands.name: get_pokemon_move
commands.description: Returns the move at the given slot

commands.name: pokemon_learn_move
commands.description: Sets the move at a given move slot to the given move. A move id of 0 deletes the move

commands.name: set_pokemon_iv
commands.description: stat = 70 + stat enum: hp - 0 attack - 1 defense - 2 speed - 3 sp att - 4 sp def - 5

commands.description: 00 Interior 01 Snow 02 Rain 03 Sandstorm 04 Snowstorm 05 Hail 06 Rainstorm (Thundurus) 07 Rainstorm (Tornadus) 08 Crystals 09 Fog (gray) 0A Fog (dark gray) 0B Fog (light gray) 0C Sandstorm (stronger) 0D Fog (dark gray) 0E Fog (light gray) 40 Normal

commands.name: wait_camera

commands.description: Restore the overworld scene after a wild battle

commands.name: wild_battle_lose
commands.description: Blackout sequence from losing a wild battle

commands.name: get_pokemon_iv
commands.description: Checks the pokemon's IVs and returns a value based on the provided type sum - 0 max - 1 hp - 2 attack - 3 defense - 4 speed - 5 sp att - 6 sp def - 7

commands.name: reload_map_here
commands.description: Loads the map again where the player stands, as the places' flags (EVENT_FLAG_BLACK2_*) and the Regi chamber (EVENT_WORK_REGI_CHAMBER) are now, so the zone's look and its level scripts follow; puts 1 in the variable, or 0 where it can't (on rails, cycling, surfing, the Union Room, the Entralink). The script's last thing: the map's actors are new after it

commands.name: party_field_move_user
commands.description: Puts the party slot of the Pokémon that uses the move in the field in the variable: the first that knows it, else, for an HM's move, the first that can learn it (not an egg); 6 if none can. The HMs' global scripts check with it
